entries.title: Mark 1:1
segments: The beginning of the Good News about Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Mark 1:2
segments: It is said in the Prophet Isaiah--'Behold! I send my Messenger before thy face; He shall prepare thy way.'

entries.title: Mark 1:3
segments: 'The voice of one crying aloud in the Wilderness: "Make ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight."'

entries.title: Mark 1:4
segments: And in fulfillment of this, John the Baptizer appeared in the Wilderness, proclaiming a baptism upon repentance, for the forgiveness of sins.

entries.title: Mark 1:5
segments: The whole of Judea, as well as all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, went out to him; and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

entries.title: Mark 1:6
segments: John was clad in clothing of camels' hair, with a belt of leather round his waist, and lived on locusts and wild honey;

entries.title: Mark 1:7
segments: And he proclaimed--"There is coming after me one more powerful than I, and I am not fit even to stoop down and unfasten his sandals.

entries.title: Mark 1:8
segments: I have baptized you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."

entries.title: Mark 1:9
segments: Now about that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

entries.title: Mark 1:10
segments: And just as he was coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent apart, and the Spirit, like a dove, descending upon him,

entries.title: Mark 1:11
segments: And from the heavens came a voice--"Thou art my Son, the Beloved; in thee I delight."

entries.title: Mark 1:12
segments: Immediately afterwards the Spirit drove Jesus out into the Wilderness;

entries.title: Mark 1:13
segments: And he was there in the Wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan, and among the wild beasts, while the angels ministered to him.

entries.title: Mark 1:14
segments: After John had been committed to prison, Jesus went to Galilee, proclaiming the Good News of God--

entries.title: Mark 1:15
segments: "The time has come, and the Kingdom of God is at hand; repent, and believe the Good News."

entries.title: Mark 1:16
segments: As Jesus was going along the shore of the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net in the Sea, for they were fishermen.

entries.title: Mark 1:17
segments: "Come and follow me," Jesus said, "and I will set you to fish for men."

entries.title: Mark 1:18
segments: They left their nets at once, and followed him.

entries.title: Mark 1:19
segments: Going on a little further, he saw James, Zebediah's son, and his brother John, who also were in their boat mending the nets.

entries.title: Mark 1:20
segments: Jesus at once called them, and they left their father Zebediah in the boat with the crew, and went after him.

entries.title: Mark 1:21
segments: And they walked into Capernaum. On the next Sabbath Jesus went into the Synagogue and began to teach.

entries.title: Mark 1:22
segments: The people were amazed at his teaching, for he taught them like one who had authority, and not like the Teachers of the Law.

entries.title: Mark 1:23
segments: Now there was in their Synagogue at the time a man under the power of a foul spirit, who called out:

entries.title: Mark 1:24
segments: "What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are--the Holy One of God!"

entries.title: Mark 1:25
segments: But Jesus rebuked the spirit: "Be silent! Come out from him."

entries.title: Mark 1:26
segments: The foul spirit threw the man into a fit, and with a loud cry came out from him.

entries.title: Mark 1:27
segments: And they were all so amazed that they kept asking: "What is this? Strange teaching indeed! He gives his commands with authority even to the foul spirits, and they obey him!"

entries.title: Mark 1:28
segments: And the fame of Jesus spread at once in all directions, through the whole neighborhood of Galilee.

entries.title: Mark 1:29
segments: As soon as they had come out from the Synagogue, they went, with James and John, into the house of Simon and Andrew.

entries.title: Mark 1:30
segments: Now Simon's mother-in-law was lying ill with fever, and they at once told Jesus about her.

entries.title: Mark 1:31
segments: Jesus went up to her and, grasping her hand, raised her up; the fever left her, and she began to wait upon them.

entries.title: Mark 1:32
segments: In the evening, after sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who were ill or possessed by demons;

entries.title: Mark 1:33
segments: And the whole city was gathered round the door.

entries.title: Mark 1:34
segments: Jesus cured many who were ill with various diseases, and drove out many demons, and would not permit them to speak, because they knew him to be the Christ.

entries.title: Mark 1:35
segments: In the morning, long before daylight, Jesus rose and went out, and, going to a lonely spot, there began to pray.

entries.title: Mark 1:36
segments: But Simon and his companions hastened after him;

entries.title: Mark 1:37
segments: and, when they found him, they exclaimed: "Every one is looking for you!"

entries.title: Mark 1:38
segments: But Jesus said to them: "Let us go somewhere else, into the country towns near, that I may make my proclamation in them also; for that was why I came."

entries.title: Mark 1:39
segments: And he went about making his proclamation in their Synagogues all through Galilee, and driving out the demons.

entries.title: Mark 1:40
segments: One day a leper came to Jesus and, falling on his knees, begged him for help. "If only you are willing," he said, "you are able to make me clean."

entries.title: Mark 1:41
segments: Moved with compassion, Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying as he did so: "I am willing; become clean."

entries.title: Mark 1:42
segments: Instantly the leprosy left the man, and he became clean;

entries.title: Mark 1:43
segments: And then Jesus, after sternly warning him, immediately sent him away, and said to him:

entries.title: Mark 1:44
segments: "Be careful not to say anything to any one; but go and show yourself to the Priest, and make the offerings for your cleansing directed by Moses, as evidence of your cure."

entries.title: Mark 1:45
segments: The man, however, went away, and began to speak about it publicly, and to spread the story so widely, that Jesus could no longer go openly into a town, but stayed outside in lonely places; and people came to him from every direction.
